exchange_rates.note: The same dated rate as the Dog Food and Cat Food batches, so every category stays consistent. Selling prices are rounded to the nearest 5 LKR.

sourcing.method: Accessories is the first batch where most manufacturers' own stores block direct downloads (petco.com 403, chewy.com 429, petsmart.com times out, moderndog.com / outwardhound.com / catit.com have no readable product feed), so the ten rows come from five brand stores that publish a public Shopify feed with exact variant prices and SKUs: waggo.com, fablepets.com, petlibro.com, petkit.com and roverlund.com.
sourcing.why_shopify: Shopify stores expose /products.json and /products/<handle>.json, which give the exact variant price, the store's own SKU and the image list for a specific variant. Each product page was then downloaded and returned HTTP 200, and the chosen pack shot was downloaded and measured (type, pixel size, byte size) before it was listed here.
sourcing.variants: Every row is a specific published variant (colour or bundle), not a price range. Where a store has one photo for several colourways and no per-variant image mapping, the unambiguous product was chosen instead: WAGGO's Splash Ceramic Dog Bowl is a single-variant product whose only photo matches its 'Black Splash' variant, and WAGGO's Habit Circle placemat photo is the black set.
sourcing.petkit_vendor_field: petkit.com's Shopify vendor field sometimes contains marketing copy rather than a brand name (for example 'Large Cat Carrier with Adjustable Ventilation & Lighting'), so the brand is taken from the product name and store domain instead.
sourcing.stock_and_ratings: No store feed reports stock counts or meaningful review counts, so stock_quantity is DEMO and rating / review_count stay NULL, as in the previous two batches.
sourcing.price_type: All ten prices are SOURCE priced from a store page, unlike the Dog Food batch where two rows had no downloadable price.

products.name: Waggo Splash Ceramic Dog Bowl
products.description: A hand-splashed ceramic dog bowl from Waggo's modern kitchen range, glazed in black so it reads as a design piece rather than plain petware. The stoneware body is a cooler alternative to plastic, and the wide shallow shape suits kibble, wet food or a water top-up.
products.image_alt: Black hand-splashed glazed ceramic Waggo Splash dog bowl on a plain background
products.notes: Single variant 'Black Splash', USD 14.00, store SKU W012031-01. Page copy: 'Good dogs deserve treats! Our modern Splash Dog bowls are a fun pop in any kitchen or living room! Hand-splashed with black glaze'.

products.name: Waggo Habit Circle Dog Placemat Set of 2
products.description: Two silicone placemats that sit under a feeding bowl to catch splashes and stop the bowl sliding on hard floors. The Habit Circle is a low-profile ring that suits a plain bowl, and the pair means one mat can stay down while the other is wiped or moved.
products.image_alt: Two black circular silicone Habit Circle dog placemats from Waggo
products.notes: Variant 'Small / Black', USD 16.95, store SKU W063621-01. The store also lists Small sets in white, rose, forest green and light grey at the same price, and Medium sets from USD 7.00 to 19.95.

products.name: Catenary Halo Ceramic Cat Bowl
products.description: A rounded ceramic cat bowl with a halo-like rim, made by Catenary and sold through Fable. The wide, shallow shape is designed to reduce whisker contact while a cat eats or drinks, and the human-grade ceramic body is dishwasher safe for everyday cleaning.
products.image_alt: Catenary Halo ceramic cat bowl with a raised halo rim, photographed on a plain background
products.notes: Single variant, USD 30.00, store SKU HALO1. The published PNG is 1915x2394 and 7.8 MB, so the image URL asks the store's image CDN for width=900, which serves the same photo at 900x1125 and 1.6 MB.

products.name: tuft + paw Porto Cat Carrier
products.description: An airline-approved soft cat carrier from tuft + paw, sold through Fable. It is built from water-resistant canvas with breathable mesh windows for ventilation and visibility, and the frame unzips flat so a removable faux-shearling bed turns the same bag into a bed at the destination.
products.image_alt: Charcoal canvas tuft + paw Porto cat carrier with mesh windows and a shearling bed, shown folded out
products.notes: Variant 'Charcoal', USD 109.00, store SKU JI-POR-O-CH. The same carrier is also listed in Sand (JI-POR-O-SD) at the same price. Highest priced row in this batch.

products.name: PETLIBRO Stainless Steel Water Fountain
products.description: A 304 stainless steel pet water fountain from PETLIBRO, sold with four replacement filters. The metal spout and bowl are BPA-free, rust and corrosion resistant, and the pump runs below 30dB, so it suits cats that are wary of moving water or households sensitive to pump noise.
products.image_alt: PETLIBRO stainless steel pet water fountain with a round drinking bowl and side filter housing
products.notes: Variant 'Fountain & 4 Filters', USD 39.99, store SKU PL-WF006-03M. Filter bundles are also published at USD 53.99 (8 filters) and USD 63.99 (12 filters).

products.name: PETLIBRO Scout Smart Pet Camera
products.description: An indoor camera for watching pets while the house is empty, with AI recognition that learns which animals are in frame. It streams to a phone app for live view and two-way talk, so a pet can be checked on and spoken to through the day.
products.image_alt: White PETLIBRO Scout smart pet camera on a stand, viewed from the front
products.notes: Variant 'White / 1 Pack', USD 79.99, store SKU PL-PC001-01W. A two-pack is published at USD 159.98, and the same camera in black at the same single-pack price.

products.name: PETKIT Breezy 2 Cat Carrier
products.description: A backpack-style cat carrier from PETKIT with a built-in fan for ventilation and a control for wind speed and light. Air vents, mesh panels and a self-locking zipper keep a cat secure, while padded shoulder straps spread the weight when it is worn for vet trips.
products.image_alt: PETKIT Breezy 2 backpack cat carrier in a pink and blue gradient, shown from the front
products.notes: Single variant, USD 74.99, store SKU BP2-Pink. The same carrier is also listed in Cream White, but that listing carries the store's placeholder SKU 'BP2-WT-test', so the gradient listing with the clean SKU was used.

products.name: PETKIT Raised Feeder Stand
products.description: A raised stand that lifts a bowl or feeder off the floor to a more comfortable eating height, which can help digestion and posture. It is moulded from BPA-free, food-grade material with anti-slip pads underneath, a cable notch for a power lead, and a surface that wipes clean.
products.image_alt: PETKIT raised feeder stand in cream, shown with a bowl resting on top
products.notes: Single variant, USD 19.99, store SKU DP1. The store's copy is written for cats: 'Elevate your cat's feeding with PETKIT Raised Stand for healthier digestion and better posture.'

products.name: Roverlund Out-of-Office Collapsible Dog Bowl
products.description: A collapsible waterproof dog bowl that folds flat for a bag or car door pocket and springs back open for water on a walk. It suits both food and water, so it works on a hike, at training class, or anywhere a public bowl is not available.
products.image_alt: Roverlund collapsible dog bowl in black, shown folded flat next to its expanded form
products.notes: Variant BLACK, USD 19.00, store SKU 11122. Blue (11184), camo (11118) and desert camo (11126) are published at the same price. Page copy: 'a collapsible waterproof bowl can be used for food or water, at home or on-the-go'.

products.name: Roverlund Leader-of-the-Pack Poop Bag Holder
products.description: A clip-on holder for a roll of poop bags that keeps waste kit off the lead handle and one-handed at the start of a walk. It is a small travel essential for dog owners who forget the bags, and it attaches to most leads and harnesses with a strap loop.
products.image_alt: Roverlund camo and orange poop bag holder attached to a lead handle with a bag roll inside
products.notes: Variant CAMO / ORANGE, USD 19.00, store SKU 11113. Five other colour pairings are published at the same price. Page copy: 'with our poop bag holder you will have no worries and a stylish and convenient way to grab your poop bags'.
